measured: 2026-10-15, mac-air (M4, 24 GB), AudioSmith 0.3.0 engine (mlx-audio-swift 244458d); thread #41, research/model-eval.md

voices.notes: Ryan: 11% word errors in both zh and en; Eric: 24% WER on Qwen3-ASR in en; Uncle_Fu/Dylan lowest naturalness in zh

qwen3-tts-0.6b-customvoice-8bit.notes: Model default 0.9/1.0 measured worse: zh UTMOS 2.70→3.25, en 4.33→4.47, seed-to-seed voice similarity 0.81→0.92 (n=6/3). Long narration inserts interjections/garbled phrases (海上来信: 「嘿嘿」「啊，他踏着树莓蹄子…」, CER 12%): not recommended for audiobook. Misreads brand words (AudioSmith→Audius Miss, App→IP). 1.8× real time, ~3.4 GB.

qwen3-tts-1.7b-base-8bit.needsVoice: a saved cloned or designed voice (its sample is the reference)
qwen3-tts-1.7b-base-8bit.notes: CER 0.8% (zh) / 0.8% (en); clone similarity 0.73–0.79 (周老师/阿杰/Sonia); default 0.9/1.0 worse in zh (UTMOS 3.05→3.30, seed similarity 0.86→0.89, n=6), equal in en. Slow on this Mac via the API: 0.35–0.55× real time (the promo measured ~1.0× in the Studio; re-check). Peak ~4.7 GB. Designed voices with weak samples (新闻主播, 老船长) drift (0.49–0.61).

qwen3-tts-0.6b-base-8bit.needsVoice: a saved cloned or designed voice
qwen3-tts-0.6b-base-8bit.notes: Long text zh CER 2.9% (= normalisation floor), en 0%; window similarity 0.89/0.94; ~0.95–1.0× real time, ~2.6 GB. Dub en→zh: 0 errors, all 5 lines fit with timing smart (3 need 1.23–1.32× under lip sync). Sampling defaults copied from the 0.6B/1.7B sweeps (same family; not swept separately).

voices.notes: af_nicole is a whisper voice: 8 silences >1 s, UTMOS 3.06. All six Chinese voices are unintelligible (CER 25–41%): hide them. #91: af_nicole and bm_lewis (NISQA 2.7, rough) scored lowest: hidden.

kokoro-82m-bf16.notes: en WER 0.2%, UTMOS 4.2–4.5, 7–13× real time, ~1.8 GB. Story: per-character similarity 0.72–0.74, smallest pitch jumps. Speed 0.9–1.1 makes no quality difference.

chatterbox-turbo-8bit.notes: en WER 0.5%, clone similarity 0.76 (Sonia), 1.5–1.7× real time, ~2.7 GB. temperature 0.5 vs 0.8: no gain (UTMOS 3.81 vs 3.95).

omnivoice-bf16.notes: Hidden under 全部模型 (CC BY-NC). zh CER 0.4%, UTMOS 3.55 (best zh), clone similarity 0.78–0.83. guidance 1.5 beats the default 2.0 (UTMOS 3.13→3.28, seed similarity 0.90→0.95); 16 steps is 2× faster, UTMOS −0.2. 0.3–0.5× real time, ~6 GB. Designed voices drift line to line (0.39–0.71); whisper archetypes fail. In the real dub with lip-sync durations it changed words (CER 17%): use timing smart.

voxcpm2-8bit.notes: Thread #165: optional, no workflow's default. Upstream defaults (10 steps, cfg 2.0). mac-air: 0.80–1.03× real time (5 steps 1.33×), MLX peak 6.2–7.0 GB for 10 s takes, 8.5 GB for a 150-character chunk; Qwen3-ASR read back every zh/en/Sichuanese/Cantonese/Vietnamese sample whole. An instruction with refText was read aloud: the engine then clones without the transcript. Long chunks may end with a filler ("嗯").

qwen3-tts-1.7b-voicedesign-4bit.notes: #41: one design drifts from line to line (ECAPA 0.29–0.64): design only, not for the four workflows. Sampling as the Qwen3-TTS family (main 2026-10-15).
